body:
I dont have that much experience with psychoactive substances; I have only ever tried cannabis (both sativa and indica) and alcohol. I would smoke weed regularly if it didnt stay in your system for so long (my employer conducts random drug tests) or have such a pungent smell. So, in search of a subtle, under-the-radar, legal high, I stumbled across the Coleus blumei plant.
Ive read everything I can about this plant and there doesnt seem to be much information out there about it.
Ive also read reports of some people experiencing vivid/lucid dreams after ingesting the plant. Some claim that its only a placebo, others say there is way too much of an effect for it not to be a placebo. So, due to a lack of dependable information on the subject, Im taking it upon myself to do my own research.
I picked up 4 of the coleus plants from Lowes on the way over to my friends apartment (they were fairly small, and there were 3 of us planning to give it a shot). The leaves were mostly green with purple speckles in the middle. I got out a strainer, picked off as many leaves as I could from each of the plants, and put them in the strainer to wash them off. After washing them off, I put them in three separate bowls for each of us (probably about 50-60 small-medium leaves in each bowl). It sort of looked like a salad.
7:45 PM.
I am writing this report as I eat the leaves, and I must say, its probably the most disgusting thing Ive ever tasted in my life. The leaves are extremely bitter. I am keeping them in my mouth until they are pulverized, then swallowing the remains.
8:05 PM.
Im finishing the last quid now, and Im sitting down with my friends to watch some Family Guy. Well see where this goes. One of my friends finished their bowl, the other didnt, as the taste was far too disgusting to handle. My mouth feels very gritty and slightly numb now from the leaves.
8:20 PM.
Im not feeling anything yet. Ive been getting up periodically to look at different sources of light to see if Im noticing any visual effects.
8:40 PM.
Still nothing, but Im not going to draw any conclusions just yet.
9:15 PM.
The only thing Im feeling at this point is some mild stomach discomfort.
9:45 PM.
The stomach discomfort is gone. At this point Im assuming I either got the wrong plant, or the other users reporting psychoactive effects were experiencing nothing more than a placebo. However, I could be wrong, as the plant supposedly has potent dream-enhancing effects. Ill find out about that later tonight.
10:40 PM.
More nausea/stomach discomfort.
11:15 PM.
Im going to bed now. Maybe Ill have a crazy dream, maybe I wont.
8:45 AM.
I just woke up. I did have an odd dream, but it wasnt any more vivid or intense than any other dreams Ive had recently. As much as Id like to credit the dream to the Coleus, Im convinced there is nothing special about this plant or I didnt eat enough. Or, maybe another method of administration would be more effective. In the future if I try plant again this I may try smoking the leaves or brewing a tea from them. But, to be quite honest, I dont really see the point. There are plenty of other more potent, guaranteed, and easily obtainable psychoactives out there.
